title: Hough Transform
text: Find lines in images, 1 input, 3 outputs, {Output data type} sets Output data type; {Theta resolution (radians)} sets the theta resolution, {Rho resolution (pixels)}, {Output theta and rho values} enables Theta and Rho output ports and {Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output theta and rho values
params.values: Enable Theta and Rho output ports off (default) | on

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type double (default) | single | Specify via Fixed-point tab

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
